training_chain: One warm-start hub1202 stage, then one warm-start polar1009 stage with same new hub; no architecture search
augmentation_visibility: Existing unknown/occluded head remains ignored; no pressure-derived point or visible flag
Photometric augmentation must retain actual visible needle/hub evidence; bounded soft highlight, no synthetic solid white occluder
If visible point neighbourhood loses contrast, fall back to the geometry-only view or mask that head out; never create a true-negative label
Affine image and original point labels share one matrix; no new point clamping
same_observation: Each synthetic view records original source SHA, view ID/seed, new hub checkpoint SHA
Polar features use the exact augmented ROI and its actual predicted new-hub center, not original/old-hub coordinates
128ROI orientation and needle angle/calibration must use the same source and coordinate convention
Any additional T-owned ROI metadata required in MCU must be identified, not assumed present from PC labels
pose_and_pressure: Only128ROI pixels and declared runtime ROI metadata are allowed as query inputs; no query true hub/tip/pressure
Static reference annotation is setup-only; no per-query ground-truth exclusion mask
Unknown orientation does not silently become zero; image roll does not certify yaw/pitch
Train-only PSI calibration; G PSI used only after output generation for scoring; old native256SIFT is a PC diagnostic, not production128 input
effect_report: All56 G gauge images remain coverage denominator;3 true negatives separate; partial/unknown visible keypoints excluded only from point-error metrics
Report readout permission changes and newly accepted errors per ID, not coverage alone
PSI errors and angular errors are distinct: G024 was13.46deg yet0.4003psi; prior large psi outlier wasG0420.8731psi
0.25/0.5/1.0psi are descriptive error bins, not user acceptance thresholds
Separate actual runtime pose+prediction from oracle diagnostics; no reference endpoint claim as actual needle tip
review_sequence: Reload exact selected weights and reproduce necessary G outputs
deployment_boundary: PC robustness does not establish integer preprocessing/TCM memory/timing/board readout or all-environment oil tolerance
